facts.fact: The National Identity Management Commission's WorkflowPro correspondence platform was developed entirely by NIMC's in-house technical team under Director-General Abisoye Coker-Odusote.
NIMC launched WorkflowPro, built entirely by its in-house team, with a 30-day transition from 17 February 2026 after which paper correspondence is no longer accepted.
